t: A fast eight-core Linux board with an NVMe slot and a 6 TOPS AI helper.
steps: Buy the board from a Radxa partner such as Arace or AmeriDroid. Check stock first, as many listings are sold out.
Get a USB-C PD power supply of 9 volts or more, such as a 30 watt charger.
Get a microSD card or an eMMC module for the operating system.
Download Radxa Debian or an Armbian image for the ROCK 5B.
Write the image to the card with an image writing app.
Connect power, an HDMI screen, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Follow the getting started pages on the Radxa docs site.
Add an NVMe SSD later for faster storage.
meta: Open Board. From $79.90. A few stores.
